#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Send an email via Fastmail JMAP. Called by Alfred with arg: "to|subject|body"
set -euo pipefail

RECENTS_FILE="$HOME/.cache/alfred-fastmail/recents.json"
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$RECENTS_FILE")"

# Parse input
IFS='|' read -r TO SUBJECT BODY <<< "$1"
TO=$(echo "$TO" | xargs)       # trim whitespace
SUBJECT=$(echo "$SUBJECT" | xargs)
BODY=$(echo "${BODY:-}" | xargs)
[ -z "$BODY" ] && BODY="$SUBJECT"

# Fetch secrets from Bitwarden Secrets Manager
BWS_ACCESS_TOKEN="$(cat ~/.config/bws/access-token)"
export BWS_ACCESS_TOKEN
SERVER_URL="https://vault.bitwarden.eu"

fetch_secret() {
  bws secret get "$1" --server-url "$SERVER_URL" 2>/dev/null \
    | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.loads(sys.stdin.read())['value'])"
}

API_TOKEN="$(fetch_secret "36c1a365-cb8d-4ca4-a7a7-b40e007a20ac")"

# Bootstrap JMAP session
SESSION=$(curl -sf -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_TOKEN" "https://api.fastmail.com/jmap/session")
API_URL=$(echo "$SESSION" | jq -r '.apiUrl')
ACCOUNT_ID=$(echo "$SESSION" | jq -r '.primaryAccounts["urn:ietf:params:jmap:mail"]')

# Get identity
IDENTITY_RESP=$(curl -sf -X POST "$API_URL" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "$(jq -n --arg acct "$ACCOUNT_ID" '{
    using: ["urn:ietf:params:jmap:core", "urn:ietf:params:jmap:mail", "urn:ietf:params:jmap:submission"],
    methodCalls: [["Identity/get", {accountId: $acct}, "i0"]]
  }')")
IDENTITY_ID=$(echo "$IDENTITY_RESP" | jq -r '.methodResponses[0][1].list[0].id')

# Get drafts + sent mailbox IDs
MBOX_RESP=$(curl -sf -X POST "$API_URL" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "$(jq -n --arg acct "$ACCOUNT_ID" '{
    using: ["urn:ietf:params:jmap:core", "urn:ietf:params:jmap:mail"],
    methodCalls: [["Mailbox/get", {accountId: $acct, properties: ["id", "role"]}, "m0"]]
  }')")
DRAFTS_ID=$(echo "$MBOX_RESP" | jq -r '.methodResponses[0][1].list[] | select(.role=="drafts") | .id')
SENT_ID=$(echo "$MBOX_RESP" | jq -r '.methodResponses[0][1].list[] | select(.role=="sent") | .id')

# Escape strings for JSON
TO_JSON=$(jq -n --arg t "$TO" '[{email: $t}]')
SUBJECT_JSON=$(jq -n --arg s "$SUBJECT" '$s')
BODY_JSON=$(jq -n --arg b "$BODY" '$b')

# Create email + submit in one JMAP call
SEND_RESP=$(curl -sf -X POST "$API_URL" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "$(jq -n \
    --arg acct "$ACCOUNT_ID" \
    --arg drafts "$DRAFTS_ID" \
    --arg sent "$SENT_ID" \
    --arg identity "$IDENTITY_ID" \
    --argjson to "$TO_JSON" \
    --argjson subject "$SUBJECT_JSON" \
    --argjson body "$BODY_JSON" \
    '{
      using: ["urn:ietf:params:jmap:core", "urn:ietf:params:jmap:mail", "urn:ietf:params:jmap:submission"],
      methodCalls: [
        ["Email/set", {
          accountId: $acct,
          create: {
            draft: {
              mailboxIds: {($drafts): true},
              to: $to,
              subject: $subject,
              keywords: {"$seen": true, "$draft": true},
              bodyValues: {text: {value: $body, isEncodingProblem: false}},
              textBody: [{partId: "text", type: "text/plain"}]
            }
          }
        }, "e0"],
        ["EmailSubmission/set", {
          accountId: $acct,
          create: {
            sub: {
              identityId: $identity,
              emailId: "#draft"
            }
          },
          onSuccessUpdateEmail: {
            "#sub": {
              ("mailboxIds/" + $drafts): null,
              ("mailboxIds/" + $sent): true,
              "keywords/$draft": null
            }
          }
        }, "s0"]
      ]
    }')")

# Check for success
ERROR=$(echo "$SEND_RESP" | jq -r '.methodResponses[] | select(.[0]=="error") | .[1].description // empty' 2>/dev/null)
SUB_ERROR=$(echo "$SEND_RESP" | jq -r '.methodResponses[1][1].notCreated // empty' 2>/dev/null)

if [ -n "$ERROR" ] || [ -n "$SUB_ERROR" ] && [ "$SUB_ERROR" != "" ] && [ "$SUB_ERROR" != "null" ]; then
  osascript -e "display notification \"Failed to send to $TO\" with title \"Email Error\" sound name \"Basso\""
  exit 1
fi

# Update recents
if [ -f "$RECENTS_FILE" ]; then
  RECENTS=$(cat "$RECENTS_FILE")
else
  RECENTS="[]"
fi

# Add to front, deduplicate, keep last 10
RECENTS=$(echo "$RECENTS" | jq --arg to "$TO" --arg subj "$SUBJECT" \
  '[{email: $to, subject: $subj, time: now}] + [.[] | select(.email != $to)] | .[0:10]')
echo "$RECENTS" > "$RECENTS_FILE"

# Success notification
osascript -e "display notification \"Sent to $TO\" with title \"Email Sent\" subtitle \"$SUBJECT\" sound name \"Glass\""

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Alfred Script Filter: parse "email <address> <subject> | <body>" input
# Output JSON for Alfred's Script Filter format
set -euo pipefail

RECENTS_FILE="$HOME/.cache/alfred-fastmail/recents.json"
INPUT="$1"

# If no input, show recents
if [ -z "$INPUT" ]; then
  if [ -f "$RECENTS_FILE" ]; then
    RECENTS=$(cat "$RECENTS_FILE")
    ITEMS=$(echo "$RECENTS" | jq '[.[] | {
      uid: .email,
      title: .email,
      subtitle: ("Last: " + .subject),
      arg: (.email + "||"),
      autocomplete: .email,
      icon: {path: "icon.png"}
    }]')
    echo "{\"items\": $ITEMS}"
  else
    echo '{"items": [{"title": "Type: address subject | body", "subtitle": "e.g. foo@bar.com Meeting tomorrow | See you at 3pm", "valid": false, "icon": {"path": "icon.png"}}]}'
  fi
  exit 0
fi

# Parse input: first word is email, rest is subject|body
read -r ADDR REST <<< "$INPUT"

# Check if it looks like an email address
if [[ ! "$ADDR" =~ @ ]]; then
  # Search recents for partial match
  if [ -f "$RECENTS_FILE" ]; then
    ITEMS=$(cat "$RECENTS_FILE" | jq --arg q "$ADDR" '[.[] | select(.email | ascii_downcase | contains($q | ascii_downcase)) | {
      uid: .email,
      title: .email,
      subtitle: ("Last: " + .subject),
      arg: (.email + "||"),
      autocomplete: .email,
      icon: {path: "icon.png"}
    }]')
    if [ "$(echo "$ITEMS" | jq 'length')" -gt 0 ]; then
      echo "{\"items\": $ITEMS}"
      exit 0
    fi
  fi
  echo "{\"items\": [{\"title\": \"$ADDR doesn't look like an email address\", \"subtitle\": \"Type a valid email address first\", \"valid\": false, \"icon\": {\"path\": \"icon.png\"}}]}"
  exit 0
fi

# We have an email address
if [ -z "$REST" ]; then
  # Just the address, no subject yet
  echo "{\"items\": [{\"uid\": \"$ADDR\", \"title\": \"Send to $ADDR\", \"subtitle\": \"Type a subject after the address\", \"arg\": \"$ADDR|No subject|\", \"autocomplete\": \"$ADDR \", \"icon\": {\"path\": \"icon.png\"}}]}"
  exit 0
fi

# Parse subject and body (split on |)
if [[ "$REST" == *"|"* ]]; then
  SUBJECT="${REST%%|*}"
  BODY="${REST#*|}"
  SUBJECT=$(echo "$SUBJECT" | xargs)
  BODY=$(echo "$BODY" | xargs)
else
  SUBJECT="$REST"
  BODY=""
fi

# Build the arg string
ARG="$ADDR|$SUBJECT|$BODY"

if [ -n "$BODY" ]; then
  SUBTITLE="Body: $BODY"
else
  SUBTITLE="Press Enter to send (add | for body)"
fi

# Use jq to safely escape
ITEM=$(jq -n \
  --arg uid "$ADDR" \
  --arg title "Send to $ADDR: $SUBJECT" \
  --arg subtitle "$SUBTITLE" \
  --arg arg "$ARG" \
  '{items: [{uid: $uid, title: $title, subtitle: $subtitle, arg: $arg, icon: {path: "icon.png"}}]}')

echo "$ITEM"
